changelog: CI recovery: Win32/COM/D3D/MediaFoundation unsafe.Pointer vet cleanup via new internal/winptr helper package (encapsulates uintptr->unsafe.Pointer reinterpretation for non-Go-managed memory). ReconnectionManager.Stop idempotency via sync.Once (fixes panic-on-close of stopCh when Stop called twice). FileTransfer ID uniqueness via atomic counter appended to timestamp (fixes silent map-overwrite under concurrent StartUpload caused by Windows 15ms timer resolution exceeding ID-call frequency). Minor test fixes: dxgi_capture_test array-length to slice (non-constant compile error), ExampleEncryptConfig expected output matched to actual deterministic 88->121 byte length.
